entry.title: The submission claims a full proof that, for every N >= 1, the maximum size of a set A subset of {1, ..., N} such that ab + 1 is nonsquarefree for every a, b in A is floor((N + 18)/25).

entry.title: The submission claims a proof of the first assertion of Erdős Problem #132 for n = 8: every eight-point planar set has two distinct distances occurring at most eight times.
